MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small Gorilla epoxy pack fits the practical repair purpose behind my tape and vinyl cement purchases, with an amount I could justify for occasional use.",
    "The single tube of silicone sealant feels useful alongside my recent duct clamps because sealing gaps is a plausible related task."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The nuts, screws and large heat shrink tubing require a particular fit or project. Buying clamps and connectors does not establish that these specific sizes would work for me.",
    "Polishing accessories and cutting wheels assume tasks and compatible tools that my purchases do not establish.",
    "The glue multipacks exceed what I want now, while the steel-reinforced epoxy serves a metal repair need I have not identified. I would choose the small clear epoxy this time."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My repair purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any hardware or workshop supply, even when its purpose is quite different.",
    "My use of Gorilla tape seems to have carried over too strongly to other Gorilla adhesives without enough attention to quantity and intended use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact dimensions and compatibility matter for clamps, connectors and related supplies; a broadly related item can still be unusable for my task.",
    "Some older purchases were bulk quantities, but that does not mean I currently need ten or twelve containers of another adhesive.",
    "My latest duct clamp purchase makes a modest sealing supply more plausible than accessories for an unrelated cutting or polishing task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specific projects, tool ownership and quantities that my current needs do not support."
}
